task: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First off, if it's not too much trouble, I need you to assure that the gate is wide open. After pulling open the gate, go south. Next, make an attempt to travel east. With that accomplished, make an attempt to move south. That done, make an effort to travel east. With that accomplished, retrieve the passkey from the floor of the attic. And if you do that, you're the winner!
